**What you asked for** — the exact trigger phrase.

**What happened** — including the frame or node it wrote, if it got that far.

**What you expected instead.**

**Mode** — CREATE / AUDIT / RE-AUDIT

**File shape** — collections present, number of modes, whether any are library collections.

**Report output** — paste the audit JSON or the failing check ID if you have it.
